headline: Microsoft refreshes its smaller Surface Pro and Laptop with Qualcomm’s X2 Plus
summary: Microsoft updates its 12-inch Surface Pro and 13-inch Surface Laptop. Devices now feature faster Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 Plus chips. They retain their previous design but come with higher price tags.

headline: Microsoft’s new Surface Mouse has haptic feedback and a customizable action button
summary: Microsoft is launching a new Surface Mouse next month. It features haptic feedback support for the first time. The mouse includes a customizable action button, primarily for Copilot access.

headline: Meta’s AI agent is a cute little guy who’s great at spending my money
summary: Meta's new AI agent, Muse, helps users manage daily tasks. The author found the AI adept at facilitating purchases and online spending. It efficiently addresses an ever-growing to-do list.

headline: Data centers are black boxes, but California wants to change that
summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed bills to increase data center transparency. New laws aim to give communities more say on data center impacts. Focus is on mitigating effects on electricity bills and water supply.

headline: Slow Horses Season 6, Episode 2 Review — ‘Daddy Issues’
summary: Review of 'Slow Horses' Season 6, Episode 2, titled ‘Daddy Issues’. Apple TV's trailer for the season spoiled the episode's ending. The reviewer expressed disappointment with the premature spoiler.

headline: Double Fine Founder Tim Schafer Questions Economics of the Game Industry Amid Mass Layoffs and Studio Closures
summary: Double Fine founder Tim Schafer questions the economics of the game industry. He no longer understands development costs after recent mass layoffs. This follows significant studio closures and Xbox layoffs.

headline: Halo Fans Are Divided Over Whether Activision Should Reboot the Series and Start Fresh
summary: Halo fans are split on the franchise's future direction. Debate centers on a potential series reboot by Activision. The alternative is continuing Master Chief's existing storyline.

headline: CyberPowerPC Gaming PCs With Founder's Edition Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 GPUs Are on Sale
summary: CyberPowerPC gaming PCs featuring Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 GPUs are on sale. The promotion is part of Walmart's GeForce Week Sale. The special offer concludes on September 27.

headline: Blood tests find high level of cancer-causing forever chemical in residents near factory
summary: High levels of cancer-causing 'forever chemicals' found in residents' blood. Discovery made near a major chemical factory in Lancashire. Residents warned of potential serious health risks.

headline: UK military jamming other nations' satellites to defend itself, BBC told
summary: The UK military is jamming hostile nations' satellites for defense. RAF head warns of "unprecedented threats" from space adversaries. A new unit is established to protect Britain's satellites.

headline: Watch: Moment pilots eject as RAF jet crashes in Anglesey
summary: Two pilots ejected from an RAF jet before it crashed in Anglesey. The incident resulted in the destruction of the aircraft. Both pilots sustained only minor injuries.

headline: Home secretary says undetected migrant landings 'unacceptable'
summary: The Home Secretary states undetected migrant landings are "unacceptable". Two unescorted migrant boats arrived, marking the first since 2025. The incident highlights concerns over border security and control.
